spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's headline use case verbatim: choose 'Press the touchpad' via buttons[i].type === 'trackpad', with the vendor-id/index-17 heuristic demoted to a clearly labelled fragile fallback.

interactive.rationale: The decide button runs the real decision against navigator.getGamepads(), prints a step-by-step trace, renders the player-facing prompt, then watches real button state via rAF to confirm the press and fire vibrationActuator.playEffect.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the prompt decision, labelled legacy fallback, haptics composition, and live-region announcements; all four are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-gamepad (names the press-a-button prerequisite), type-exposed-but-no-trackpad, attribute-absent-with-heuristic-match, heuristic-miss, and missing vibrationActuator — each surfaced honestly, never as fake success.

references.rationale: See-also links the explainer's trackpad use case and the ChromeStatus entry.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite carries the trackpad contract as a manual hardware assertion (dualsense-touchpad-reports-trackpad) rather than pretending it is automatable.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven Chrome 141 run: decide clicked with no pad — trace, prompt line, basis, and live-region announcement all show the honest no-gamepad branch (interact-adaptive-prompts.png), console clean; the trackpad decision, press confirmation, and rumble need real hardware plus a CL-7760763 build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts adaptive-prompt-decision-ran on the primary action, adaptive-prompt-no-gamepad-fallback on the fallback branch, and adaptive-prompt-press-confirmed on hardware confirmation.

design_system.rationale: Prompt screen is ivory-on-black with the basis line in bg-stone on black (both AA); the simulated panel is fenced in a rose dashed border with a rose/ivory label so it cannot be mistaken for live output.

accessibility.rationale: Prompt decisions and press confirmations are announced via a polite role=status live region; glyphs are aria-hidden with the decision carried in text; the simulated panel is labelled in text, not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check desktop OK clean, mobile OK: panels collapse to one column, the trace pre wraps with overflow-wrap:anywhere, decide button exceeds 44px.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the modern decision path and rumble on real Sony hardware
openQuestions.detail: With a DualSense on a build containing CL 7760763 plus the GamepadButtonTypes flag, verify the trace takes the MODERN PATH (buttons[17].type === 'trackpad'), the press-watch confirms on the touchpad press specifically, and vibrationActuator.playEffect resolves 'complete'. Also verify the legacy path label appears when the flag is off on the same pad.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria live region announcing dynamic status updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce meaningful state changes through polite live regions and never encode meaning in colour or emoji alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every decision and confirmation writes a sentence to a role=status aria-live=polite region including the basis; the prompt glyph is aria-hidden decoration duplicated by text.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid panels should collapse to one column on narrow viewports with long strings allowed to wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: 760px single-column collapse; trace and basis lines use overflow-wrap:anywhere so long gamepad.id strings cannot overflow the 360px viewport.

summary: The cloud-gaming prompt use case, composed with vibrationActuator haptics and live-region announcements. Verified headlessly on Chrome 141: the no-gamepad fallback names the exact prerequisite, the simulated example panel is loudly labelled, console clean. Hardware paths recorded as open work.
